newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds firm ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds firm ahead of FOMC.

text.p: 1610 GMT - Austrian bonds and futures firmed in low volume on Tuesday as the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) met in the U.S. but traders noted that the Vienna market had failed to keep pace with advances in Germany.
Traders said they had factored in a 25 basis points increase in U.S.short-term interest rates but forecast a bigger hike would exert downward pressure on German and Austrian bonds.
* Benchmark 10-year 6.25 percent up five bps at 100.10 to yield 6.23 (6.24) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.17/27 to yield 6.22/21 percent.
* At the near end, five-year 5.25 percent bond maturing March 2001 down five bps at 101.25 to yield 5.19 (5.18) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 101.19/27 to yield 5.21/19 percent.
* 10-year spread to German bunds up one bp at seven bps, five-year up four at 27 bps.
* December AGB future up 22 bps at 104.30 on volume of 190 contracts.
* Money market rates mixed with 3-month VIBOR steady at 3.342 and overnight money firmer at 3.00/3.25. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 254
